dedupe_keys.name: nyc zoning tax lot database and zola zoning and land use map

description: The NYC Zoning Tax Lot Database from the Department of City Planning is a CSV file of up-to-date zoning by parcel, giving the zoning designations and zoning map for each tax block and lot; it is described as updated monthly for rezonings and corrections, with earlier versions kept on DCP's BYTES of the BIG APPLE pages, and the NYC Open Data copy was last updated on 5 April 2026. ZoLa, New York City's Zoning and Land Use Map, is DCP's open-source web map for researching zoning regulations, current proposals and planning initiatives for a property; it draws layers such as zoning and subways from DCP's layers API and supports links by borough, block and lot (BBL) identifiers. Coverage: New York City. Access: free CSV download and web map. Licence: NYC Open Data terms. Caveats: zoning designations are not the zoning text, and the Open Data copy can lag DCP's own release. Simulation uses are allowed-use and density constraints for redevelopment and future building stock scenarios. Related records: NYC PLUTO and MapPLUTO.
